thinkingSteps.title: Aha insight
thinkingSteps.body: To set the entire row and column to zeros if an element in the matrix is zero, we can use two sets to keep track of the rows and columns that need to be set to zero. We iterate through the matrix and mark the corresponding rows and columns in the sets. Then, we iterate through the matrix again and set the elements to zero if their row or column is marked.
